messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 09:15 AM -0700
Subject: Close-window autopsy & owner action — commit vs shelve for holdlist

Team —

We ran the post-close autopsy on the 3/31 holdlist this morning. Attached is the export (holdlist_export_20270331.csv) with current SFDC stage + close dates. A few notes and asks: 

- Goal: by EOD Monday 4/4, each owner needs to either (A) provide commit evidence and keep the close date, or (B) shelve the opportunity (move to Deferred / Archive) so our forecast is clean.
- What counts as commit evidence: signed SOW, confirmed PO email from customer finance, or a vendor PO/contract number. If you're relying on a verbal commitment, get the PO/confirmation into writing before 4/4.
- Please update SFDC fields: Stage, Close Date (if changing), and add a note referencing the evidence file name. If you plan to shelve, set Stage=Deferred and add reason.

Action items:
- Lauren: triage the 8 medtech deals — assign owners for any unclaimed rows.
- Monica: I flagged CuraHealth (Deal D-18294) as a soft commit — please share status and add any evidence to the thread.
- Markus: run a quick validity check on any >$150k deals for revenue recognition implications.

I'll follow up once owners have posted evidence. If we don't see a valid PO or signed SOW by 4/4, we'll move the deal off-commit for forecasting.

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Documentation: add the evidence filename to the SFDC Files/Notes section and link the HubSpot deal (link in metadata). If anyone needs me to adjudicate borderline cases, drop the row number in this thread and I'll review.
